question: Can any power other than Kāmātmikā bestow the wealth of spiritual attainments?
premises: The statement excludes Kāmātmikā as absent
No other is a giver of the wealth of siddhis
inference: Kāmātmikā alone is the source of the wealth of spiritual attainments
plain_english: Without Kāmātmikā, no other gives the wealth of spiritual attainments.
